title: land moves the intake drafts in the checkout it runs in aside, as it does for a worker's worktree
goal: backlog.py land, run in a checkout holding untracked kb/_self/backlog/*.json intake drafts (those whose links carry a fingerprint and a detector) and no other change, moves them to _cache/intake-drafts/ of the clone and says so before its clean-tree step, then lands; the drafts stay there when land stops at a later step; any other untracked or modified file still stops it at clean tree. Answers the SP-gkbtjjce retrospective: land stopped twice at clean tree because the orchestrator's own SessionStart hook re-filed a drift draft in its checkout, which the orchestrator moved by hand; ST-ocfkanth and ST-bum7owtw cover only worker worktrees.

gates.question: When land has moved the checkout's intake drafts aside and then stops at a later step, do the drafts stay in _cache/intake-drafts/ or are they put back?

notes: The work extends test_land_e2e.py with a planted draft in the checkout land runs in (the test name land_moves_own_checkout_drafts is the check's selector, a test yet to write: tests.py exits 2 until the work adds it; the former check, the lint e2e test, passed before the work and proved nothing). SP-2vhfsn4o evidence: the orchestrator moved intake drafts out of its checkout before each landing, and one landing (ST-dku4a6ob) stopped at clean tree on two drafts a session start filed meanwhile. Orders after ST-gdcn5467, which moves INTAKE_ASIDE to bl_intake.py. Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 5 of 13, "Headless sprint loop 2: intake drafts, land windows and worker cost"); the triage reviewer found it serves the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test F2: a content sprint from the research queue lands on headless Sonnet workers. Premise run at planning (2026-10-10): _tools/bl_land.py land_once opens with git status --porcelain and refuses at step clean tree on any line, with no call of intake_drafts or set_aside_drafts before it: reproduces. The planted test also plants one non-draft untracked file and expects the refusal at clean tree.
